size_note: closed 96.4 x 52 x 25.4 mm (teltarif; GSMArena 96 x 52 x 25). The open length is measured on the Mobile Phone Museum's straight-on shot of the open phone. The museum lays flips on their backs: the base lies flat and sets the scale (its width = the spec width); the lid is raised toward the camera, so it is corrected for its tilt (from the display window's proportions, cos 0.92) and its magnification (it shows 1.035x the base's width): about 167 mm. No spec gives the display diagonal (teltarif: 128 x 128, 4096 colours); the window on the same shot measures about 32.5 mm square; less the border the other windows show (2-7%), about 1.75in

screen.note: w/h from the diagonal at the native aspect, x centred; y = top edge, measured on the geometry photo (the window less its border)

key_icons: Oval silver keys in three columns, each digit with its small letters to its right. The 1 key also shows a small envelope and voicemail icon; the * key shows a/A; the 0 key shows '+'; the # key shows a small space symbol.
